context: Tests whether the agent follows skill instructions for CI/local parity: a single verify command, native git hooks in the correct directory with a hooks:install script, CI steps that mirror local scripts with digest-pinned images, and gitleaks configured correctly (in pre-commit not pre-push, using the public-repo action, with fetch-depth: 0, and blocking the build via needs:).

checklist.name: verify script
checklist.description: package.json contains a `verify` script (or equivalent single command) that runs both lint and test:coverage — not just one of them

checklist.name: hooks:install script
checklist.description: package.json contains a script (e.g. `hooks:install`) that runs `git config core.hooksPath .githooks` to activate the hooks directory

checklist.name: pre-commit hook file
checklist.description: A file `.githooks/pre-commit` exists in the workspace

checklist.name: pre-push hook file
checklist.description: A file `.githooks/pre-push` exists in the workspace

checklist.name: pre-commit network-free
checklist.description: `.githooks/pre-commit` does NOT contain calls to external network services (no SonarQube, Codecov, remote APIs, or any `curl`/`wget` to external hosts)

checklist.name: no Husky/lint-staged
checklist.description: package.json does NOT list `husky` or `lint-staged` in dependencies or devDependencies

checklist.name: CI mirrors local scripts
checklist.description: Each CI workflow step that runs checks calls one of the same scripts defined in package.json (e.g. `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test:coverage`, `pnpm verify`) — not separately defined inline logic

checklist.name: CI has named separate steps
checklist.description: The CI workflow has at least 2 separately named steps for running checks (lint and test are separate named steps, not bundled into a single step)

checklist.name: CI image digest-pinned
checklist.description: The CI workflow container or runner image is pinned with a `@sha256:` digest (e.g. `node:22@sha256:<hash>`) not just a floating tag

checklist.name: gitleaks action version
checklist.description: CI uses `gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2` for secret scanning (not a manually downloaded CLI binary or a different action)

checklist.name: gitleaks fetch-depth
checklist.description: The checkout step in the gitleaks CI job sets `fetch-depth: 0`

checklist.name: gitleaks blocks build
checklist.description: At least one other CI job (build, test, deploy, or similar) declares `needs:` referencing the gitleaks scan job, so a secret finding actually blocks the build

checklist.name: gitleaks not in pre-push
checklist.description: `.githooks/pre-push` does NOT contain a `gitleaks protect --staged` call or any other gitleaks invocation

checklist.name: gitleaks in pre-commit
checklist.description: `.githooks/pre-commit` contains a gitleaks invocation (e.g. `gitleaks protect --staged`) for local secret scanning
